services.desc: The Beeville Art Museum is a teaching museum promoting education through creative exploration. Tours aim to stimulate the imaginations of young people. BAM Education Programs are designed to correlate with the Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills (TEKS). Programs are available for students grades PreK -12. BAM and the Joe Barnhart Foundation have been working together for more than 20 years to bring amazing experiences to BISD students and teachers including FREE tours and classes for all students. In addition, the Foundation partners with Writers in the Schools to bring creative writing workshops to all students and assists in purchasing art materials for teachers in all school levels.
